text.title: Architectural Impact PR Ranking — Procedure
text.summary: Nine steps that produce the weekly report in the order the numbers depend on each other: fix the session and population, commit the public API path list per repo, publish the weights, compute signals from the diff, weight dependency changes by kind, rank and cut N to the time-box, reconcile exclusions and list what merged without review, record last week's hits, then validate and publish. Each step names its rule and the skeleton section it fills.

step.name: fix-session-and-population
step.input: The review slot and its time-box (45 minutes by default); the list of repositories; the previous report's window end.
step.action: Record `session.slot` and `time_box_minutes`, the `repositories[]` to scan, and `window.from` / `to` as timestamps over PRs opened or merged, never state = open. Fill `# Header` in `templates/skeleton.md.j2`.
step.decision-gate: Without a time-box and a population there is nothing to rank against (decision tree root; r-window-repos-exclusions-stated).

step.name: commit-public-api-path-list
step.input: Each repository's schema, migration, export, event and CLI paths.
step.action: For each repo commit a version-controlled list (OpenAPI, protobuf, GraphQL, AsyncAPI files, package entry points, migrations, event schemas, CLI flags) and record its path as `public_api_paths_config` with `has_public_api_list` true; a repo without one is recorded false and scores 0 on `public_api_delta`.
step.decision-gate: Guessing the API surface from file names is fm-undefined-public-api; print "no API surface list" instead (r-public-api-surface-enumerated-per-repo).

step.name: publish-weights
step.input: The current weights; the precision record of the last four sessions if a change is proposed.
step.action: Set `weights` for the five signals and `dependency_kind_weights` with lockfile_only 0 and patch bumps below new dependencies and major bumps. If a weight changes, set `weights_changed` true and fill `weight_change` with the previous weights and at least four weeks of precision. Fill `# Weights`.
step.decision-gate: A weight change with fewer than four weeks of recorded precision is fm-weights-tuned-by-feel (r-precision-recorded-per-session).

step.name: compute-signals-from-diff
step.input: For every PR in the window: `git diff --name-status` and `--stat`, the manifests, and the public API path list.
step.action: Compute `modules_touched`, `public_api_delta`, `contract_changes` and `infra_or_config_changes` from the file list and diff only; set `signals_from_diff_only` true. Show title and labels as `title_context`, never in the score.
step.decision-gate: A scorer that reads title, body, labels or author is fm-title-driven-score (r-signals-from-diff-not-metadata).

step.name: weight-dependency-changes-by-kind
step.action: Classify each manifest change as new dependency, major bump, minor or patch bump, or removal; score lockfile-only churn 0; sum by `dependency_kind_weights` into the PR's `dependency_changes` signal.
step.decision-gate: Bot patch bumps at the top of the list is fm-bot-bumps-on-top (r-dependency-change-weighted-by-kind).

step.name: rank-and-cut-to-session
step.input: Scores per PR; `changed_lines` and an estimated `read_minutes` per PR; `time_box_minutes`.
step.action: Sort by score, take PRs above `review_threshold`, and choose `top_n` so `summed_read_minutes` fits `time_box_minutes`; list the rest above threshold in `deferred[]` with their scores. Fill `# Ranked` and `# Deferred`.
step.decision-gate: A top N the session cannot finish is fm-top-n-exceeds-session (r-top-n-fits-the-session).

step.name: reconcile-exclusions-and-merged
step.input: Every PR in the window; the exclusion rules (bot authors, reverts, docs-only, generated files); merge events.
step.action: Count each exclusion, count `below_threshold`, and check ranked + deferred + exclusions equals `population_total`. List every PR above threshold merged before the session in `merged_without_review[]` with score, `merged_at` and `merged_by`; print an empty list when there are none. Fill `# Exclusions` and `# Merged without architecture review`.
step.decision-gate: Totals that do not reconcile, or a missing merged-without-review section, are fm-merged-before-session-invisible (r-window-repos-exclusions-stated, r-merged-without-review-flagged).

step.name: record-last-session-precision
step.input: The previous report's ranked list; the architect's hit / miss marks from that session.
step.action: Mark every previously ranked PR hit or miss, compute `previous_precision` as hits over n, and print it in the header; set `outcome` pending on this week's ranked PRs for next week.
step.decision-gate: A ranked PR from last week with no mark means the precision cannot be computed and no weight may change (r-precision-recorded-per-session).

step.name: validate-and-publish
step.input: The filled skeleton and its JSON form.
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-architectural-impact-pr-ranking.py --file <report.json>`; fix every violation; publish the report before the session and link the ranker run and the previous report in `evidence[]`.
step.output: A report that validates, ready for the session.

list.item: A sceptical reader can recompute every ranked score from the printed signals and weights.
The ranked list fits the time-box and the totals reconcile to the population.
Merged-without-review is printed and last week's precision is in the header.
